snapshot: CivicState is a candidate civic-letter business; paid demand and operator intent remain unproven.
authorityAdoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning files and implementation files.
Compared roadmap, current-state, stale audit, package identity, source code, and tests.
Tagged repo-backed claims as evidence and external market claims as assumptions.

sources.use: Product name, package description, workspace scripts
Original thesis, pricing, constraints, validation gates
Original phase narrative and completion claims
Stale audit and original asset claims
API route surface and Bull Board mount

thesis.current: CivicState can become a paid civic advocacy workflow if residents pay for researched, routed, citation-backed constituent letters.
thesis.evidenceStatus: Implementation evidence exists; customer demand evidence was not found.
thesis.operatorDecisionNeeded: Confirm whether this watchlisted personal/research asset should pitch as a business.

real: Express API mounts submissions, officials, payments, campaigns, webhooks, admin, compliance, and queue monitoring.
Worker registers classifier, researcher, drafter, delivery, treasury, and reconciliation agents.
Prisma schema models core users, submissions, campaigns, letters, officials, payments, deliveries, jobs, ledger, audit, and agent logs.
Tests cover pricing, submission validation, moderation, payment concepts, compliance, delivery, treasury, and admin flows.

variablePlatformCost.honesty: assumption: weighted formula using test cost references

lowMonthlyFixedCost.honesty: assumption: 96 evidence droplet plus 100 evidence local-provider low end

highMonthlyFixedCost.honesty: assumption: 96 evidence droplet plus 500 evidence local-provider high end

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up scenario model because external research was unavailable.
marketSizing.formula: paid civic jobs per year x blended AOV = annual gross revenue

scenarios.name: operator_scale_base
scenarios.honesty: mixed: jobs evidence from .planning/existing-state.md planned scale; revenue assumption formula

scenarios.name: venture_proxy_tam
scenarios.honesty: assumption: placeholder pending external demand research

marketSizing.caveat: TAM is not validated and should not be used as fundraising evidence.

customerDefinition.primary: United States resident with a concrete civic complaint or policy request who wants researched, routed, professional constituent communication.
customerDefinition.buyer: The resident, not the government official.
excluded: Users seeking legal advice or regulatory filings

competition.name: Resistbot
competition.risk: May own low-friction constituent messaging behavior.

competition.name: Change.org
competition.risk: Has petition audience and sharing mechanics.

competition.name: Quorum
competition.risk: Enterprise incumbent can copy organization-facing research and workflow features.

competition.name: VoterVoice
competition.risk: Organization budgets may be more attractive than individual transactions.

competition.name: LegalZoom
competition.risk: Users may confuse cited civic letters with legal help.

competition.name: Direct official websites
competition.risk: Free manual substitute caps willingness to pay.

risksAntiPlan.antiPlan: Do not pitch as VC-backable until paid demand, operator intent, legal-safety workflow, and deliverability are evidenced.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Run paid beta and measure preview-to-payment conversion.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Users may like the concept but still not pay.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Warm domain, track bounces, pause risky domains, sample inbox placement.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Officials may classify paid civic letters as spam or bulk advocacy.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: Legal-adjacent and defamatory submissions create safety risk.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Block threats, queue defamation-risk content, require manual review for edge cases.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Moderation misses can create reputational or legal exposure.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: Citation accuracy unproven at production scale.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Verify citations programmatically and manually sample letters before delivery.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Wrong citations damage trust and increase support load.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Operator must resolve Brooks History versus CivicState positioning.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Data room appears confused until naming is resolved.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Residents will pay for convenience, research, and routing.

assumptionLedger.test: Controlled public pages and search-impression tracking

assumptionLedger.assumption: Citation verification can make AI research trustworthy.
assumptionLedger.basis: requirements and code exist; production accuracy unproven

assumptionLedger.assumption: One operator can run launch operations.
assumptionLedger.test: Track queue depth, oldest flagged item, and support time

goToMarket.primaryHypothesis: SEO-led acquisition around controlled civic issue pages.
goToMarket.secondary: Direct paid beta from curated issue categories and local use cases.
constraints: No paid acquisition until conversion is measured.
No open-ended public publishing until moderation and defamation policy are validated.
Manual review on outgoing letters during launch.

honestyLabels.policy: Every quantitative claim in BUSINESS.md is tagged as evidence or assumption.
honestyLabels.externalMarketClaims: All external market claims are assumptions because network research was unavailable.

staleSignals: .planning/existing-state.md says zero application code exists, but app code now exists.
.planning/ROADMAP.md says all phases complete, but .planning/STATE.md and .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md disagree.
External market facts were not refreshed due to workspace-only mode.

surpriseSpikes: Dispatch identity says Brooks History while code and planning identify CivicState.
Roadmap completion claims conflict with requirements and state files.
Existing-state audit is stale relative to current app code.
Registry watchlist posture conflicts with confident business language in older planning.
